claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: CI-966 is a brain-penetrant GAT-1 GABA uptake inhibitor whose pharmacology is CNS-restricted; at 2.5 uM in a 5-day pooled cancer cell line viability screen it is expected to be largely inactive, with any killing attributable to nonspecific physicochemical effects rather than a defined cytotoxic mechanism.
